firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently put a crown or hat on their head starts.
clarifications: That player places their Thief figure on a red Start/Arrival circle first; the other players place theirs clockwise before play begins.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 1 states the crown-or-hat criterion and initial Thief placement in clockwise order. The English/French booklet shows the Thief and Guard figures, crowns and doors listed for inventory BGG 340346; its publisher is Exclusive Games.
